messages:
maria (support): heads up — acme reported their canary rollout rlt_0921 stuck 'in progress' in console for ~12h, UI spinner and health chart not updating. they hit this after a manual rollback earlier today. raising P1 :rotating_light:
kevin (sre): thx. can you paste the rollout id + customer org id and any console errors you see?
maria (support): rollout=rlt_0921, org=acme-inc. console shows: 
```
GET /api/rollouts/rlt_0921/status 200 OK (cached)
ws://status-stream -> connected but no events for 12h
server logs: status_sync: upstream 504 Gateway Timeout to events-processor
heartbeat.last_seen: null
```
Users report API for status returns "in_progress" unchanged. They also saw a spike in 502s to /events ingestion earlier.
seth (eng-runtime): ok i'm looking. any chance event stream lagged or consumer fell behind? can you share the last event id in the ui payload?
maria (support): ui payload has last_event_id: ev_19877, server side shows last_processed_event: ev_19860. gap 17 events.
kevin (sre): running quick check on kafka consumer group offsets now. if offsets are stuck we may need to restart consumer or replay.
deploy-bot: deploy rlt-0921-status-fix v2.3.1 -> canary started at 1827502600 by seth (status-sync-retry), health check: in_progress
seth (eng-runtime): logs from events-processor show repeated timeouts to redis: 
```
ERR: redis timeout connecting to kv-cache (timeout=2000ms)
WARN: status-sync: failed to ack event ev_19866 -> retrying
```
seth (eng-runtime): hypothesis: kv-cache timeouts cause status sync to fall back to read-from-stream behavior but the consumer stops acking and UI continues to show stale in_progress. also saw increased latency to authorizer for that customer (auth service 503s around 03:15-03:40 UTC).
jane (product): acme is calling support repeatedly. can we give them a temporary workaround?
maria (support): told them to stop new rollouts, and we can flip their project to polling mode (not ideal) — would like eng to confirm.
kevin (sre): i can force a consumer restart on the cluster node hosting events-processor-acme (node: infra-04-eu). will close the consumer lag if it succeeds.
seth (eng-runtime): please hold on restart — i'll patch status-sync to tolerate redis timeouts (backoff + local buffer) and push a hotfix. if restart is needed i'll coordinate.
kevin (sre): restarted consumer group acme-events @ 1827502765, offsets advanced to ev_19877, no further backlog.
maria (support): confirmation from customer: UI updated at 03:46 UTC, canary status moved to 'healthy' and chart backfilled. acme says they saw a brief increase in latency but resolved. :white_check_mark:
seth (eng-runtime): thanks — PR open with retry/backoff + metrics around redis timeouts. i'll link issue to rollout-sync bug and add a test for consumer ack path.
jane (product): filing an incident summary for customers -> note root cause: status-sync dependency (kv-cache/redis) timeouts -> consumer ack gap -> UI stale 'in_progress'. mitigation: consumer restart and status-sync hotfix. next steps: alert on consumer lag + redis timeout SLI.
maria (support): verified with acme and marked incident resolved. follow-ups for eng: backfill telemetry, add automated retry, and add a customer-facing note in console when status stream is delayed.
kevin (sre): closing thread but will monitor until SLA window passes. :eyes:
